title: Blink timer wraps around
prompt: A blinking light keeps a timer t that grows by delta each frame and wraps back to the start every period seconds. Return the new t after adding delta and wrapping if it reached the period.
signature: func solve(t: float, delta: float, period: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(t: float, delta: float, period: float) -> float:
	return t + delta
hint: Add first. Then, if the result is at least the period, subtract the period.
